definitions.gloss: long seat for several people; bench; couch
definitions.explanation: A seat long enough for two or more people, such as a bench in a waiting room, a pew, or a sofa. Literally "long chair".

examples.japanese: {長椅子|ながいす}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{座|すわ}る→座る：00757_suwaru⟧。
⟦{待合室|まちあいしつ}→待合室：07373_machiaishitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{長椅子|ながいす}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{待|ま}った→待つ：00469_matsu⟧。
examples.english: I waited on the bench in the waiting room.

examples.japanese: ⟦{疲|つか}れていた→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{居間|いま}→居間：01745_ima⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{長椅子|ながいす}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{横|よこ}→横：02984_yoko⟧になった。
examples.english: I was tired, so I lay down on the couch in the living room.

notes:
A slightly old-fashioned, descriptive word. In everyday speech a padded one at home is ⟦ソファー→ソファー：05607_sofaa⟧, and one in a park or station is ⟦ベンチ→ベンチ：00013_benchi⟧; {長椅子|ながいす} is common for the plain benches of hospitals, waiting rooms and churches.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {長椅子|ながいす}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{腰掛|こしか}ける→腰掛ける：13945_koshikakeru⟧: to sit down on a bench
- {長椅子|ながいす}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{横|よこ}になる→横になる：05546_yokoninaru⟧: to lie down on a couch

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ベンチ→ベンチ：00013_benchi⟧: bench — outdoors, in parks, stations and sports grounds
- ⟦ソファー→ソファー：05607_sofaa⟧: sofa — padded, at home or in a lounge
